title: Chapter 254 Thirty Thousand Vs. Six Thousand
content:
Chapter 254 Thirty Thousand Vs. Six Thousand

But there were several leaders who took the initiative to ask for help. If he couldn't shrink back, wouldn't he look too timid.

Lin Guanru was a little confused.

He raised his eyes and looked at Ni Wu, and finally decided to let the main force defend the enemy outside the city gate.

The first battle must be fought beautifully and the reputation of Nanshanji must be established.

When making pre-war deployments, he had not thought about asking other town mayors for help. On the one hand, it was because he had absolute confidence that he could defeat Wang Shuo, including gang members.

There are more than 30,000 combatants in Nanshanji, five times as many as Wang Shuo's troops, and they are still defending the city. He will never believe that such a war cannot be won.

On the other hand, I also don’t want to lose face and make people laugh.

He must use a big victory to establish the reputation of Nanshan Ji.

"Okay, I appointed Utuk as the commander-in-chief, responsible for defeating Wang Shuo's troops, and appointed Ni Wu as the vanguard, commanding 200 guards."

Utuke is Lin Guanru's direct unit. He is usually responsible for the security affairs of the entire Nanshanji. He is Lin Guanru's most trusted general.

When Ni Wu heard that he was only given 200 guards, he felt a little disappointed, but his expression remained unchanged and he immediately accepted the order.

Raduer also wanted to show off, with an eager look on his face.

But Lin Guanru ignored him, after all, he only had so many troops.

Utuk took away 600 people. As the main force, there were only 200 people left to defend the city.

There is really no extra manpower to allocate to others.

There is no upper limit on the number of gang members who can participate in the battle, but they must all obey Utuk's command.

Soon, Nanshanji gathered 20,000 troops.

At the same time, a large number of lords personally led their troops and marched towards Nanshanji from all directions.

Many of them have a spectator mentality.

If Nanshan Ji was defeated, they would rush in and rob it. If Wang Shuo was defeated, they would beat up the drowned dog.

Wang Shuo learned all this news through his spies and smiled in his heart.

In a plain area ten miles away from Nanshanji, Wang Shuo stationed his army, waiting for the arrival of Nanshanji's army.

Wang Shuo has cavalry, so the choice of battlefield is very critical.

Utuk did not want to confront Wang Shuo here, but Ni Wu insisted on rubbing Wang Shuo's spirit and chose to continue marching.

Many people are paying attention to this battle.

Both the players in the Dahuai Territory and the lords outside the Dahuai Territory are paying attention to this battle.

After hearing the news in Wu'an Village where Fang Kai was located, Dongfang Ling clamored that he must lead troops to support.

After Dongfang Ling was killed by Toad Brunei, he used resurrection props to randomly teleport to other places.

After Fang Kai found Dongfang Ling, Dongfang Ling finally gave up the idea of looking for Wang Shuo immediately under the earnest persuasion of Xu Qing and others.

Fang Kai's trip had two purposes, one was to protect Dongfang Ling, and the other was to establish a force in the Great Sophora Territory.

Dongfang Ling also knew that Qingyang City was in a worrying situation and had to expand new territory.

In order to take the overall situation into consideration, he could only stay with Fang Kai and build the territory together.

But at this time, she couldn't sit still.

"Fang Kai, I order you to lead troops to fight." He mumbled and yelled loudly.

Fang Kai was reluctant in his heart, but he couldn't resist Dongfang Ling, so he took 500 people and headed towards Nanshanji.

But his Wu'an village is still more than 100 kilometers away from Nanshanji, and the traveling speed along the way is not very fast.

Dongfang Ling could only worry.
